The fix is a one-line change: the cycle detection now compares the number of ordered nodes against the full node set (`deps`, which includes nodes that appear only as dependencies) rather than just the keys of the input dict. Previously, when the acyclic portion of the graph produced more results than there were input keys, the `len(result) < len(graph)` check passed even though cyclic nodes were silently dropped.
